description: TY2026: the classic S-corp owner split — $60,000 reasonable-compensation W-2 wages (payroll-taxed, QBI-excluded) + $120,000 K-1 ordinary income (no SE/payroll tax, QBI-eligible). AGI 180,000; TI before QBI 163,900 under the $201,750 threshold; QBI = min(24,000, 32,780) = 24,000; TI = 139,900 -> 1,240+4,560+12,166+24%x34,200=8,208 -> $26,174.00.
